featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s a wonderful place if you want to enjoy the seashore view from the Malabar Hill side. It’s perfect when you just want to stand, observe, and take everything in.

From there, we could also clearly see the Babulnath Temple, which many people refer to as Babulnath Temple Kailash. I wasn’t very aware of this earlier, but yes, we could see it closely from here.

There are a total of four, out of which three were operational when we visited. Overall, the experience was great. This is actually a BMC viewing gallery. From the curved edge of the gallery, you can see so many surrounding landmarks and views.

Lift access is available till the top floor, and from the second to the third floor as well. Unfortunately, the ground-floor entry was closed at that time. The best part is that there is no entry fee.

featured_reviews.name: Vin Chenzo
featured_reviews.review_text: One to visit. You get good views over Mumbai and it's beaches. A lift is available so accessibility is good. There's also a star that echos when you stand in the middle of it which I found unique and interesting. No entry fee.

featured_reviews.name: Chandni N. Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Concept: Named after Prabodh Navalkar, it promotes open-air workouts and a healthy lifestyle for all age groups.
•	Facilities: Equipped with outdoor gym machines, jogging tracks, and areas for basic exercises—perfect for those who prefer fitness in natural surroundings rather than indoors.
•	Atmosphere: Clean, green, and buzzing with people early morning and evening, yet peaceful enough to feel rejuvenating.
•	Community Feel: You’ll find a mix of regulars—from seniors walking to youngsters exercising—which gives the place a welcoming, neighborhood vibe.
•	Overall: A well-maintained, thoughtful initiative that blends fitness with nature. If you’re in the area, it’s worth checking out for a workout or even just a refreshing walk.

featured_reviews.name: rohit boddu
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is the fantastic location to enjoy a panoramic view of Mumbai's famous Girgaon Chowpatty and Marine Drive! Situated in Malabar Hill next to the Hanging Gardens, this spot offers an excellent vantage point to soak in the beauty of the city skyline and the Arabian Sea.

Having multiple telescopes available adds an exciting element to your visit, allowing you to get a closer view of various points in the vicinity. With these telescopes, you can observe landmarks, architecture, and the bustling activities along the coastline with greater detail.

Enjoying the view from Malabar Hill provides a unique perspective of Mumbai, especially during sunrise or sunset when the city is bathed in golden hues. Additionally, the Hanging Gardens nearby offer a serene environment for a leisurely stroll before or after taking in the breathtaking scenery.

featured_reviews.name: Parag
featured_reviews.review_text:
The most unique vantage point overlooking South Mumbai and the sea. The binoculars along with angle charts for spotting prime locations is a wonderful concept.

Best time to visit: Avoid early morning visits since the ascending sun will strain your eyes and the heat will be unbearable. I presume the view in the evening will be the best, with the sun behind your back.

Entry fee: Free

The eco point near the entry gate is mind blowing.

featured_reviews.name: natasha chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was eight months pregnant last year when I got in touch with Anupa for my shoot. I stay in Ahmedabad so Anupa had to travel here for a day from Bombay.
It was monsoon time and of course the rain played truant with our outdoor shoot plans.
However Anupa was a rockstar and a brilliant photographer. She worked with the rain and shot the most beautiful pictures of me with my bump. She was aware of my tiredness and the time crunch - we only had a day- and managed to get all the shots I wanted and some more ! We had an indoor shoot after and my space had a lot of lighting constraints for her. Yet she thought on her feet and delivered the loveliest pictures of me. The best part is her creative use of any space she shoots in. She uses it thoroughly to her advantage and comes up with brilliant shots. Absolute genius!
It’s been 8 months since we shot together and I find myself often looking back on the pictures she took. I look radiant happy and to my eyes beautiful. I credit this solely to Anupa. She didn’t get frazzled with the rain, with my exhaustion, with the time crunch or space constraints. She worked with everything like a pro and delivered the best to me. Additionally she has the kindest attitude and coolest temperament. I am not fond of shoots and I am also camera shy. But with gentle and intelligent coaxing she got me to emote and actually enjoy myself during the shoot.
After a long time in the pregnancy I felt good and a bit like myself. I recommend Anupa blindly to anyone looking for a photographer to not only capture them at their best but to make them feel beautiful about themselves.
I am waiting for her to do my baby shoot next!

featured_reviews.name: Archeeta Pujari
featured_reviews.review_text: Anupa was my wedding photographer. From the very beginning, she was a delight to work with, responsive to text messages and taking a personal approach. One of the big pluses is that she is an honest business owner and doesn’t ask for payment in cash to evade taxes (unlike the others I contacted)! Her fees are very reasonable for the time and quality of service she provides. She took a lot of interest in getting to know us and our style and likes and dislikes (including asking us to fill out a great questionnaire!). On the day she was a fun and friendly presence and many of the guests enjoyed interacting with her. She and her colleagues were complete professionals, and took some fantastic shots. It is clear from the end product that she absolutely tailored her style to take my preferences and requests into account - she did not deliver a one size fits all. The album was delivered on time and is of exceptional quality. Thanks for capturing the lovely memories ! I could not recommend more.

featured_reviews.name: Raj
featured_reviews.review_text:

Anupa is also incredibly organized, responsive, and attentive, which made the entire process smooth and stress-free. I enjoyed working with her and would highly recommend her.
